        depth = int(mlp.depth)

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))

        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)
            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi

class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        try:
            budget_value = float(budget)
        except Exception:
            budget_value = 0.0

        per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 4 * width))
        n_samples = max(1024, int((0.0909908329 * budget_value) / float(per_sample)))
        n_samples = min(n_samples, 8192)
        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        half = n_samples // 2
        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = vecs @ (fnp.diag(1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12))) @ vecs.T)
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * xm
            elif i == 1:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * xm
            elif i == 3:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * xm

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        zc = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(zc * zc, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        try:
            budget_value = float(budget)
        except Exception:
            budget_value = 0.0

        per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 4 * width))
        n_samples = max(1024, int((0.0909908329 * budget_value) / float(per_sample)))
        n_samples = min(n_samples, 8192)
        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        half = n_samples // 2
        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = vecs @ (fnp.diag(1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12))) @ vecs.T)
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * xm
            elif i == 1:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * xm
            elif i == 3:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * xm

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        zc = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(zc * zc, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def _phi2_cdf(self, a, b, rho):
        rho = fnp.minimum(fnp.maximum(rho, -0.995), 0.995)
        base = flops.stats.norm.cdf(a) * flops.stats.norm.cdf(b)

        nodes = (-0.9602898565, -0.7966664774, -0.5255324099, -0.1834346425,
                 0.1834346425, 0.5255324099, 0.7966664774, 0.9602898565)
        weights = (0.1012285363, 0.2223810345, 0.3137066459, 0.3626837834,
                   0.3626837834, 0.3137066459, 0.2223810345, 0.1012285363)

        total = 0.0
        half = 0.5 * rho
        ab = a * b
        aa = a * a
        bb = b * b
        for x, wt in zip(nodes, weights):
            r = half * (x + 1.0)
            omr2 = fnp.maximum(1.0 - r * r, 1e-8)
            expo = -(aa - 2.0 * r * ab + bb) / (2.0 * omr2)
            total = total + wt * fnp.exp(expo) / (6.283185307179586 * fnp.sqrt(omr2))

        return fnp.minimum(fnp.maximum(base + half * total, 0.0), 1.0)

    def _relu_full(self, mu, cov):
        var = fnp.maximum(fnp.diag(cov), 1e-12)
        sd = fnp.sqrt(var)
        alpha = mu / sd
        phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
        cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

        out_mu = mu * cdf + sd * phi
        out_e2 = (mu * mu + var) * cdf + mu * sd * phi
        out_var = fnp.maximum(out_e2 - out_mu * out_mu, 0.0)

        si = sd[:, None]
        sj = sd[None, :]
        ai = alpha[:, None]
        aj = alpha[None, :]
        mui = mu[:, None]
        muj = mu[None, :]

        rho = cov / fnp.maximum(si * sj, 1e-12)
        rho = fnp.minimum(fnp.maximum(rho, -0.995), 0.995)
        s2 = fnp.maximum(1.0 - rho * rho, 1e-8)
        s = fnp.sqrt(s2)

        phii = flops.stats.norm.pdf(ai)
        phij = flops.stats.norm.pdf(aj)
        pa = phii * flops.stats.norm.cdf((aj - rho * ai) / s)
        pb = phij * flops.stats.norm.cdf((ai - rho * aj) / s)

        p = self._phi2_cdf(ai, aj, rho)
        f2 = fnp.exp(-(ai * ai - 2.0 * rho * ai * aj + aj * aj) / (2.0 * s2)) / (
            6.283185307179586 * s
        )

        iu = pa + rho * pb
        iv = pb + rho * pa
        iuv = rho * p + s2 * f2 - rho * (ai * pa + aj * pb)

        raw = mui * muj * p + mui * sj * iv + muj * si * iu + si * sj * iuv
        out_cov = raw - out_mu[:, None] * out_mu[None, :]
        out_cov = out_cov + fnp.diag(out_var - fnp.diag(out_cov))
        return out_mu, out_cov

    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        means = []

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        cov = None

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights):
            if i == 0:
                pre_mu = w.T @ mu
                pre_cov = w.T @ w
            else:
                pre_mu = w.T @ mu
                tmp = cov @ w
                pre_cov = w.T @ tmp

            pre_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.diag(pre_cov), 1e-12)
            pre_sd = fnp.sqrt(pre_var)
            alpha = pre_mu / pre_sd
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)
            layer_mu = pre_mu * cdf + pre_sd * phi
            means.append(layer_mu)

            if i + 1 < int(mlp.depth):
                mu, cov = self._relu_full(pre_mu, pre_cov)

        return fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(means, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
